CAPTAIN KIM KOREAN BBQ & HOTPOT (HALAL)
TAMPINES JUNCTION & JUNCTION 10

At Captain Kim, we take pride in offering a delightful fusion of Halal Korean BBQ and Hotpot, all at an affordable price. With three conveniently located outlets at Tampines, Bukit Panjang and Clementi, we are the top choice for company and family gatherings. Our buffet spread is meticulously curated under the watchful eye of Captain Kim himself, ensuring that every ingredient meets the highest standards of quality and freshness. With over 60 varieties of top-notch meats and ingredients to choose from, you can indulge in a wide range of perfectly marinated meats and an array of delectable options.

Whether you crave the sizzling grills of Korean BBQ or the comforting warmth of Hotpot, we have it all to satisfy your taste buds. Whether you find yourself in the East or the West, when the desire for a deliciously-fresh and affordable buffet strikes, Captain Kim warmly invites you to our doorstep.

As a MUIS Halal-certified establishment, we are dedicated to ensuring that our offerings adhere to strict halal standards. We strive to provide a comfortable and inclusive dining experience for all our guests. With our commitment to quality, variety, and affordability, we have established ourselves as one of the top choices for halal-certified Korean BBQ and Hotpot in Singapore.

PROMOTIONS

STUDENT 2PLUS1 PROMO

EVERY MONDAY LUNCH & DINNER ONLY

  • Guest coming for 2+1 Student Monday Promo MUST prebook on web link and key in “2+1M” under Reservation Notes. Once verified by restaurant staff, student diners will be given the “2+1M” student promo pricing written on the bill chit.
  • All Guests have to follow our FB/IG page to enjoy the promo.
  • Student Guests who did not book online with “2+1M” in Reservation Notes will not be provided the promo pricing on their bill chit.
  • Valid Student Pass must be presented upon request and age not exceeding 23.
  • Limited to 80mins dining time.
  • Min 3 students to dine in.
  • Not applicable for use with any other promos, vouchers & discounts.
  • Valid on every Monday for 1 – 31 Oct 2026.
  • Example: To enjoy 2+1 must be minimum of 3 student diners; if it is 4 student then 3 pays 2+1 while the 4th pays regular price or regular student price.

EARLY BIRD PROMO

Mon – Fri Lunch: $14.9++/pax [11:30am-12pm Timeslots Only]
Mon – Fri Dinner: $21.9++/pax [5:30pm Timeslots Only]
Sat – Sun Lunch & Dinner: $21.9++/pax [5pm-5:30pmTimeslots Only]

  • Guest coming for Early Bird Promo MUST prebook on web link and key in “EB” under Reservation Notes.
    Prior to entry guests have to inform host that they are using the promo before entering. Once verified by restaurant staff, diners will be given the early bird promo pricing written on the bill chit.
  • Guests MUST follow our Facebook / Instagram to enjoy the promo.
  • All Guests have to follow our FB/IG page to enjoy the promo.
  • Limited to 80mins dining time.
  • Min 2 paying pax to dine in.
  • Lunch discount is only applicable during 11:30am – 12pm timeslots.
  • Dinner discount is only applicable during Weekday 5:30pm timeslots (Weekends & PH 5pm – 5:30pm).
  • Not applicable with other promos, vouchers & discounts.
  • Valid from 1 – 31 Oct 2026.

4PLUS1 PROMO

Mon - Sun Lunch & Dinner

  • 1 pax dines free with every 4 other full-paying pax. Free pax has to be the lowest paying diner.
    Eg 1) 5 Adult Diners = 1 Adult Dines Free
    Eg 2) 3 Adult Diners + 2 Student Diners = 1 Student Dines Free
  • Guests MUST follow our Facebook / Instagram to enjoy the promo.
  • Guest have to inform host that they are using the promo before entering.
  • Valid from 1-31 Oct 2026.
  • Limited to 90 mins dining time. Guests have to leave by the stipulated timing to enjoy the promo.
  • Not applicable with other promos, vouchers & discounts.
  • Promo is not applicable for Gebiz
